title: Punish the Queen
setup: The black queen has just swooped in with check, straight into your rook's line of sight.
hint: Yes, the king can sidestep. But look down the h-file before you touch it.
explanation:
## The Idea

The queen on h4 checks your king along the diagonal to e1, and stepping aside feels natural. But the queen has landed on the open h-file, where your rook on h1 is waiting.

{{Rxh4}} captures the checker outright: the check is gone and nine points are won. A king move such as {{Kd2}} does the opposite, because {{Qxh1}} takes your rook instead.

A checking piece has to stand somewhere, so ask what you attack on that square.
